phase_name: Per-cell integration + cell-level validation under reframed criteria
overall_outcome: 0/4 cells pass reframed criteria — catastrophic failure across all cells

dominant_failure_diagnosis.primary: Path 2 deploys channels Nicoletti's fit omitted (gbar=0); most prominently NCA in AVAL where Nicoletti set gbar=0 but CeNGEN reports nca-2 = 153.2 TPM
dominant_failure_diagnosis.secondary: AIY/RIM small-cell under-channeling (Phase 5 Pattern A) means insufficient K efflux to balance Na/Ca influx
dominant_failure_diagnosis.tertiary: AVAL/AVAR IRK over-channeling (Phase 5 Pattern B) provides more K efflux but doesn't compensate for NCA Na influx

third_methodology_lesson.name: Channel-inclusion audit
third_methodology_lesson.description: Inherited fits encode IMPLICIT CHANNEL INCLUSION/EXCLUSION decisions (gbar=0 is an inclusion decision: 'functionally negligible'). Substrate methodology must decide whether to honor or override these decisions based on gene expression.
third_methodology_lesson.forward_looking: Layer 2-7 inherit-and-compose work blocks should check for gbar=0 / parameter=0 entries in inherited models and explicitly authorize override-vs-honor decisions

beta_1_smallest.name: Per-channel E_translation respecting Nicoletti omissions
beta_1_smallest.scope: Set E_translation = 0 for channels Nicoletti omitted (e.g., NCA in AVAL)
beta_1_smallest.methodology_cost: Deviates from 'all channels from biology' contribution

beta_2_medium.name: Refit gamma_NCA + gamma_IRK
beta_2_medium.scope: gamma_NCA from 5 pS placeholder to ~0.5-1 pS (NALCN literature gap); gamma_IRK from 25 pS chord to ~12 pS slope-midpoint
beta_2_medium.methodology_cost: Maintains 'all channels from CeNGEN' but adjusts per-channel intrinsic gamma
beta_2_medium.fixes_pattern: Pattern B (IRK over) + indirectly Pattern A by reducing NCA contribution

beta_3_full.name: Per-cell-family C_global
beta_3_full.methodology_cost: Loses 'single global constant' contribution; adds 3 calibration anchors

recommended_order: Deploy β-2 first (refit γ_NCA + γ_IRK); if AVAL/AVAR pass but AIY/RIM still fail, deploy β-3 (per-cell-family C_global); if all of β-2 + β-3 still fail, consider β-1 or Option γ (Path 1 fallback)
